cohort: Participants were women with term singleton vaginal deliveries at a single academic hospital over 10 years, excluding cesarean deliveries and multiple gestations.
finding: A machine learning model, specifically CatBoost, achieved an AUC of 0.83 for predicting shoulder dystocia, with sonographic estimated fetal weight, maternal BMI, and clinical estimated fetal weight identified as key predictive features.
birth_weight: Mean birthweight in the SD group was 3751g and 3287g in the non-SD group.
